title: candidate-level facts bridge: transcribes prepareDecisionRequest(CANDIDATES_ONLY) candidate identity and public snapshot, per-candidate DECISION_VISIBLE preview atomic facts, and PrototypeDirectAdapterV1 admit/project output into the BehaviorImmediateFeatureV1 input contract production subset; one pass per candidate and per effect; explicit rejections, pending, deferred and untranscribed accounting; paymentMode derived (never fabricated); ZERO supported projection is a fatal contract violation; BIF caps (CAP_EXCEEDED, MAX_WORK_UNITS_PER_CALL=200000) referenced as whole-compile rejections; no selection, no TopK, no future route, no result world, no hidden facts, no teacher in production closure.

authority.claimDetail: freezes the transcription bridge input/output shape, lifting rules and accounting; PrototypeDirectAdapterV1 revision 5 scheduled rows are transcribed verbatim, including stable ownerId/followUpKey on FOLLOW_UP rows; the BIF input contract is BehaviorImmediateFeatureV1 inputContract revision 6; this contract is not an implementation claim.

sources: prepareDecisionRequest CANDIDATES_ONLY frozen candidate identity (candidateId, actorId, actorSide, actionKind, targetSet, paymentMode)
prepareDecisionRequest CANDIDATES_ONLY visibleWorld public snapshot (units, sides, actorStatus)
per-candidate previewAction basis DECISION_VISIBLE atomic contributions with finite expectedDelta and finite evidence.hitProbability

PrototypeDirectAdapterV1 revision 5 admit/project rows: directFacts, legalityModifiers, opportunityModifiers, scheduledFacts, unsupportedOutcomeKinds, deferCode; FOLLOW_UP rows retain stable non-empty ownerId/followUpKey
candidate declaration public costs (魂力/精神力/体力/生命) and public hit probability evidence
candidate declaration payment fields: candidate.paymentMode, declaration.paymentMode, candidate.resourcePotentialOnly
inputSurface.timing: BEFORE_CANDIDATE_FREEZE; one pass per candidate and per effect; no branch combination; no candidate selection or TopK

paymentModeDerivationV1.rule: priority chain: 1) candidate.paymentMode when present; 2) else declaration.paymentMode when present; 3) else candidate.resourcePotentialOnly === true => EXTERNAL_TIMELINE; 4) else FORMAL. The emitted BIF candidate.paymentMode is always a non-empty string; the bridge never omits it and never lets the harness fabricate FORMAL.
paymentModeDerivationV1.note: paymentMode is identity only for the feature compiler; EXTERNAL_TIMELINE is an opaque non-empty string, no special-casing downstream.

perCandidateOutput.candidateId: string, non-empty, at most 512 characters, rejects C0/DEL control characters; equals the prepared candidate identity

bifInput.shape: production subset of BehaviorImmediateFeatureV1 inputContract revision 6: candidate, publicSnapshot, atomicFacts, directFacts, legalityModifiers, opportunityModifiers, scheduledFacts, mechanicMetadataEntries, projectionFamilies, publicCost, publicProbability, publicDeclarations

lifting.mechanicMetadataEntries: aggregated from PrototypeDirectAdapterV1 opportunityModifiers.mechanicMetadataEntries across all effects of the candidate into one closed array; values are verbatim normalized deep clones, deep-frozen and never re-interpreted or scored; multi-effect entries are kept per effect instance
lifting.projectionFamilies: aggregated from PrototypeDirectAdapterV1 opportunityModifiers.projectionFamilies; closed [{sourceEffectId, prototype}] entries; routing identity only, never a weight
lifting.scheduledFacts: PrototypeDirectAdapterV1 revision 5 scheduledFacts rows verbatim; no repack; every scheduledFacts row (WINDOW_ADJUST/SETTLEMENT_RATIO_ADJUST/FOLLOW_UP/SUMMON_WINDOW) already carries entryId = sourceEffectId + ':schedule:' + 0-based index inside that effect's own scheduledFacts array; FOLLOW_UP rows retain ownerId/followUpKey and the triggerKey/maxActions constraint
lifting.opportunityModifiers: transcribed minus the lifted mechanicMetadataEntries and projectionFamilies keys

rejections.shape: array of closed rejection records, one per rejected effect instance
rejections.note: the REJECTED_INPUT_WITH_REASON code enum covers every PDA mechanical rejection code in PrototypeDirectAdapterV1 (four formal codes plus INVALID_OPTION_VALUE/MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD/UNKNOWN_RULE/AMBIGUOUS_TAUNT_TARGET); UNSUPPORTED_CARRIER_REQUIRES_UNPACK stays its own kind; rejection records are never remapped into BIF hardExclusions.

pdaPending.shape: array of closed pending records, one per pending effect instance; mechanically valid input is never disguised as mechanical illegality

pdaDeferred.shape: array of closed deferred records, one per effect instance whose PDA project returned a deferCode; deferred effects stay admitted and are never disguised as pending or rejected

untranscribedPreviewFacts.shape: explicit count plus reason list for every preview contribution that is not transcribed into atomicFacts; UNKNOWN is never represented as 0

noOfficialEffectMaterialization.shape: array of closed records for candidates whose action kind carries no official effect object in CANDIDATES_ONLY prep
noOfficialEffectMaterialization.note: the implicit base-action public mechanics must be materialized upstream from preview public operands; the bridge never invents a skill effect object and never masks the absence with INVALID_OPTION_VALUE

totals.shape: candidateCount, pdaItems, compiledCount, rejectionSum, pendingSum, deferSum, fatalSum, untranscribedSum; all non-negative integers; rejectionSum/pendingSum/deferSum/fatalSum/untranscribedSum equal the sums of the per-candidate records
totals.compiledCount: number of candidates whose bifInput was produced

untranscribedPolicy: every preview contribution that is not transcribed into atomicFacts is counted with an explicit reason from the frozen five-word vocabulary (non-finite expectedDelta, non-finite hitProbability, missing outcomeKind, missing eventId, unmatched contribution source); UNKNOWN is never represented as 0; no silent drop and no invented reasons
publicDeclarationsPolicy: publicDeclarations is emitted only when the candidate declaration carries the public reveal fields (revealStrength, declaredOverkill) with an explicit source; when no source exists the key is omitted entirely - no default values, no empty object
zeroProjectionPolicy: an effect that is admitted as SUPPORTED (no rejection, no carrier, no defer, no pending) and yet projects zero directFacts/legality/opportunity/scheduled rows is a FATAL CONTRACT VIOLATION (kind ZERO_SUPPORTED_PROJECTION with the effect identity); it is never disguised as pending, deferred or silently omitted; totals.fatalSum counts every such record

hardExclusionMapping.rule: only the ten BIF formal hard-exclusion codes are ever present on the bridge output
hardExclusionMapping.forbidden: legacy R9 codes are never forwarded; the bridge maps to the BIF formal codes or reports UNKNOWN, it does not pass through old codes

noOfficialEffectPolicy.action: record a noOfficialEffectMaterialization record with the base-action kind and the upstream materialization note; upstream materializes the implicit effect from preview public mechanics
noOfficialEffectPolicy.never: never synthesize a skill effect object; never use INVALID_OPTION_VALUE to disguise a missing official effect

durationPolicy.transformationOnly: 变身期间 duration is PENDING_DURATION_PROJECTION; the bridge never forges a turn count
durationPolicy.windowAdjust: missing window adjustment fields (window.adjustTurns/window.settlementRatio) are strict PENDING; no compatibility fallback

complexity.note: C=candidates; F0=fixed candidate-scope facts; R_c=directFacts rows; N_c=modifier/scheduled/metadata entries; one pass, no cross-row/cross-branch combination product. BIF caps are referenced from BehaviorImmediateFeatureV1 rev6: work units = F0(13) + directFacts rows + modifier entries + scheduledFacts entries + atomicFacts entries; any breach (features>256, rows>128, modifiers>64, work>200000) is a whole-compile CAP_EXCEEDED rejection of the candidate; the bridge never pre-prunes candidates and never uses wall clock.

selfConsistency: bifInput mirrors the production subset of BehaviorImmediateFeatureV1 inputContract; the bridge never emits the test-only keys forbiddenFacts/branchCombination/preMultiplied
mechanicMetadataEntries is a closed array of {sourceEffectId plus prototype-allowed Chinese field-name keys}; values are verbatim and never interpreted or scored
projectionFamilies is a closed array of {sourceEffectId, prototype}; routing identity only

scheduledFacts are PDA revision 5 verbatim rows; every row carries entryId = sourceEffectId + ':schedule:' + 0-based index inside that effect's own scheduledFacts array, and FOLLOW_UP retains stable non-empty ownerId/followUpKey with the triggerKey/maxActions constraint
untranscribed preview facts are counted with explicit reasons; UNKNOWN is never 0
hardExclusions carry only the ten BIF formal codes; legacy R9 codes are never forwarded
no-official-effect candidates are recorded with kind and upstream materialization note; no invented skill effects
totals equal the sums of the per-candidate rejections, pending, deferred, fatal and untranscribed records
paymentModeDerivationV1 priority chain always yields a non-empty paymentMode on the emitted BIF candidate; harness never fabricates FORMAL
pdaDeferred kinds are exactly DEFER_MECHANICS_PROJECTION/DEFER_LEGALITY_INJECTION/DEFER_REPORT_PROJECTION; deferred effects stay admitted and are never relabeled pending or rejected
zeroProjectionPolicy: SUPPORTED with no projection is fatal ZERO_SUPPORTED_PROJECTION, never pending, never silent
publicDeclarations is emitted only with an explicit public source; otherwise the key is omitted
BIF CAP_EXCEEDED is referenced as whole-compile rejection (never candidate pruning, never wall clock); MAX_WORK_UNITS_PER_CALL=200000 mirrors BehaviorImmediateFeatureV1 rev6
